tool.name: Generate data

param.name: arange
param.label: Return evenly spaced values within a given interval. (see numpy.arange). Provide the parameters in the form start,stop,step ; for example "0,10,2".
param.help: Return evenly spaced values within a given interval. (see numpy.arange). Provide the parameters in the form start,stop,step ; for example "0,10,2".

param.name: linspace
param.label: Return evenly spaced numbers over the specified interval (see numpy.linspace). Provide the parameters in the form start,stop,num,endpoint ; for example "0,10,50,True" or "-5, 5".
param.help: Return evenly spaced numbers over the specified interval (see numpy.linspace). Provide the parameters in the form start,stop,num,endpoint ; for example "0,10,50,True" or "-5, 5".

param.name: logspace
param.label: Return numbers spaced evenly on a log scale (see numpy.logspace).
param.help: Return numbers spaced evenly on a log scale (see numpy.logspace).

param.name: geomspace
param.label: Return numbers spaced evenly on a log scale (a geometric progression, see numpy.geomspace).
param.help: Return numbers spaced evenly on a log scale (a geometric progression, see numpy.geomspace).

param.name: input_dataframe
param.label: Input DataFrame (CSV)
param.help: Optional CSV file containing input DataFrame for batch processing

tool.help: Generate a DataFrame from the given values, range or space. See the numpy documentation on array creation routines for more information (arange, linspace, logspace and geomspace, https://numpy.org/doc/stable/reference/generated/numpy.arange.html).
